verses.text: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
lines: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction,
but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

verses.text: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.
lines: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things,
but the unfaithful crave violence.

verses.text: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
lines: He who guards his mouth guards his soul.
One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

verses.text: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
lines: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing,
but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

verses.text: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
lines: A righteous man hates lies,
but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

verses.text: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.
lines: Righteousness guards the way of integrity,
but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

verses.text: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
lines: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing.
There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

verses.text: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.
lines: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches,
but the poor hear no threats.

verses.text: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
lines: The light of the righteous shines brightly,
but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

verses.text: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.
lines: Pride only breeds quarrels,
but wisdom is with people who take advice.

verses.text: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.
lines: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away,
but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

verses.text: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.
lines: Hope deferred makes the heart sick,
but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

verses.text: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.
lines: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it,
but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

verses.text: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.
lines: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life,
to turn from the snares of death.

verses.text: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.
lines: Good understanding wins favor,
but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

verses.text: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.
lines: Every prudent man acts from knowledge,
but a fool exposes folly.

verses.text: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.
lines: A wicked messenger falls into trouble,
but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

verses.text: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.
lines: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline,
but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

verses.text: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.
lines: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul,
but fools detest turning from evil.

verses.text: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
lines: One who walks with wise men grows wise,
but a companion of fools suffers harm.

verses.text: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
lines: Misfortune pursues sinners,
but prosperity rewards the righteous.

verses.text: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
lines: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children,
but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

verses.text: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.
lines: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields,
but injustice sweeps it away.

verses.text: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.
lines: One who spares the rod hates his son,
but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

verses.text: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
lines: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul,
but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
